blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Supreme Court (SC) has declared Republic Act No. 12326 constitutional, upholding the extension of the terms of office of barangay officials and Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) members to five years and setting the next Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections (BSKE) in November 2028.
